narrative.intro: Thalle Construction obligated $1.9B in federal contract dollars in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction received 3 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $638M. Thalle Construction's obligations are up 571.1% year over year. The Department of Defense obligated $1.9B to Thalle Construction in FY2026 to date, making the Department of Defense the dominant buyer. The Department of the Interior obligated $114K to Thalle Construction in the same period. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the largest market for Thalle Construction at $1.9B. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction is a secondary market at $114K. Historical obligations show variability: FY21 was $167M, FY22 was $213M, FY23 was $16.1M, FY24 was $366M, and FY25 was $285M. Current-year totals are partial and reported as fiscal year to date, and the largest share of FY2026 obligations is tied to defense-related heavy and civil engineering construction.

sections.heading: Who are Thalle Construction's biggest federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the largest federal customer for Thalle Construction, obligating $1.9B in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior is a distant second, obligating $114K. Agency concentration is high because the Department of Defense accounts for the vast majority of current-year obligations.

sections.heading: What work does Thalle Construction perform for the government?
sections.body: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the primary work category for Thalle Construction, with $1.9B in obligations in FY2026 to date. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction is a much smaller category with $114K in obligations.

faq.q: How much does Thalle Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Thalle Construction obligated $1.9B from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction received 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $638M, and obligations are up 571.1% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Thalle Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys most from Thalle Construction, obligating $1.9B in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior also buys from Thalle Construction, obligating $114K.

faq.q: What does Thalle Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Thalle Construction sells heavy and civil engineering construction work to the government, specifically categorized as Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with $1.9B in obligations. Thalle Construction also performs work in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction, with $114K in obligations.
